scope: Seven verified pre-registered documentation sources. Three inaccessible registered URLs remain pending; no new external sources.

verified_claims: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 is a voluntary, risk- and outcome-based, technology/sector/law/jurisdiction-agnostic tool.
It comprises Core, Profiles and Implementation Tiers for communicating privacy outcomes and priorities.
records.boundary: It is not legally binding and does not replace jurisdiction-specific law or legal advice.

verified_claims: The AWS guidance describes GenAI data lifecycle stages including preparation, integration with retrieval/fine-tuning workflows, feedback collection and ongoing updates.
It describes RAG as adding external-knowledge ingestion and filtering pipelines around an LLM and recommends encryption, fine-grained access control and TLS/SSL in its guidance.
records.boundary: AWS guidance is not a cross-cloud mandatory standard; controls must be adapted to the actual system and jurisdiction.

verified_claims: Sentence Transformers CrossEncoder applies a pretrained Transformer with a score/label head; reranking commonly uses one label while multiclass tasks configure the class count.
CrossEncoderTrainer accepts Dataset or DatasetDict and the documentation highlights negative-example quality and hard-negative mining as training considerations.
records.boundary: This supports the documented API and training practice only; it does not prove business-task model effectiveness and page behavior can change by version.

verified_claims: Confluent Schema Registry compares schema versions under configurable compatibility modes; BACKWARD is the default and TRANSITIVE checks all historical versions.
BACKWARD, FORWARD and FULL define the documented consumer/producer compatibility directions, subject to schema format rules.
records.boundary: These semantics apply to Confluent Schema Registry and its supported formats; format-specific rules and policy configuration remain relevant.

verified_claims: The Debezium Outbox Event Router defaults to id, aggregatetype, aggregateid, type and payload fields; aggregatetype routes the topic, aggregateid is the Kafka key and id is placed in a header.
The documented SMT expects INSERT outbox records, filters DELETE and makes UPDATE handling configurable; payload format is configurable.
records.boundary: This is specific to the Debezium Outbox Event Router SMT and its configuration; MongoDB connectors require their documented alternative.

verified_claims: Microsoft Foundry deployment types distinguish Global Standard, Data Zone Standard and Standard geography processing scopes, while Provisioned provides guaranteed throughput and lower latency variance in the documented comparison.
Standard is best-effort and Developer has no SLA or data-residency guarantee in the page's stated terms; model support varies by deployment type.
records.boundary: These are Microsoft Foundry SKU semantics, not general cloud or legal guarantees; model and region availability require separate checks.

verified_claims: SPDX License Expressions represent single or compound license identifiers; OR expresses alternatives, AND expresses combined applicability and WITH expresses an exception.
The normative grammar supports license-id, LicenseRef, NONE and NOASSERTION, with operator precedence WITH over AND over OR and restrictions on combining NONE/NOASSERTION with WITH.
records.boundary: The RC1 annex defines machine-readable expression syntax, not the legal rights, jurisdiction or compliance outcome of a license.
